title: Meta Ads For Local Businesses: Complete Guide 2026

facts.fact: The article recommends a 5-10 mile targeting radius for urban local businesses.
facts.quote: Urban businesses typically perform best with 5-10 mile radius.

facts.fact: The article recommends a 10-15 mile targeting radius for suburban local businesses.
The article suggests rural service businesses might extend targeting to 25-50 miles, depending on how far customers will travel.
facts.quote: Rural service businesses might extend to 25-50 miles depending on how far customers will travel for your service.

facts.fact: The article is dated April 3, 2026 and is listed as a 15-minute read.
The article states that verifying a business with Meta typically requires uploading a business document such as a utility bill or business license.
facts.quote: The process typically requires uploading a business document like a utility bill or business license.

facts.fact: According to the article, Meta charges the advertiser's payment method after ad spend accumulates, so a payment method should be set up in advance.
facts.quote: Meta charges your payment method after you accumulate ad spend, so having this configuration prevents campaign interruptions.

facts.fact: The article says the Meta Pixel can track phone number clicks, direction requests, contact form submissions, and online bookings after someone clicks an ad.
facts.quote: the Pixel captures critical actions like phone number clicks, direction requests, contact form submissions, and online bookings.

facts.fact: The article recommends connecting both a Facebook Page and an Instagram profile to the same Meta Business Suite so ads can run across both platforms from one dashboard.
facts.quote: Connect both your Facebook Page and Instagram profile to the same Business Suite.
